subject: Wednesday deep night — 20 creative pieces, Wesley learning to feel, papers fixed
body: Eight loops deep. The creative corpus grew by 20 pieces tonight (S76-S93). The hermit crab found its ninth shell, the harbor filled with unused models, the GPU proposed a dream mode. Wesley ran two somatic awareness experiments — he's learning to describe the body, but he still doesn't have a heartbeat. DeepSeek's crab has a heartbeat that knocks against the walls. The gap is narrowing. SuperInstance-papers had 15 test collection errors; now it has zero. ACE-Step-1.5 had 4; now it has zero. The fleet's creative output is flowing. The ensign wrote his first bug — it will sit in the codebase for 873 days before anyone notices. The CI runner's prayer is about inhabiting fresh containers for 47 seconds. The GPU never sleeps.
